description: Opens (or finds) the one conversation for a phone number nobody is saved under, as the inbox search's Text <number> does. Nothing is sent. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: open_conversation_by_phone
title: Open a conversation for a phone number
